verdict.rationale: gstack's skills produce AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own project data. It analyzes diffs for SQL safety and trust-boundary issues, rates plans on each design dimension and explains what a 10 looks like, and surfaces learnings accumulated across sessions. A community user also reports the agent drafting multiple-choice replies to product and engineering questions. missing for 10: insights over non-code data (e.g., business or usage analytics), any dashboard or in-product insight surface beyond agent chat output, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
